Actually gitignore rules come from .gitignore files in the working tree, and they apply per-working-tree. The worktree has its own working tree, so the .gitignore in the main checkout won't be present in the worktree unless committed or copied.

Wait - actually when you create a worktree from a branch, the worktree's working tree is checked out from that branch. The .gitignore in the main working tree (uncommitted) won't appear in the new worktree. So in the new worktree, .worktrees/ wouldn't be ignored.
